selectionRule: Only dependency-clean Consume candidates classified simple-consume by the hardened profiler, with positive HP/MP-only restore behavior, no special/system flags, a v95 String.wz name, and no semantic duplicate in canonical v83 data.
requiredBeforeApproval: Recompute donor diff and item profile from the pinned private archives
Verify each candidate sourcePath and sourceSha256 still match
Verify v95 String.wz name and description parity
Verify canonical v83 has no colliding item ID
Verify client Item.wz and String.wz nodes can be patched together
Verify server item loading and use behavior in isolated staging
Verify inventory stack, consume, trade, drop, storage, shop-sell and persistence behavior
Run real-client staging smoke before any production release
